description: Versatile modal dialog with header (title, subtitle, icon), scrollable body, and configurable footer with OK/Cancel buttons. Supports multiple sizes, positions, overlay click dismiss, and escape key handling.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Extra content rendered in the header row, between the header content and the built-in close button, wrapped in .tm-modal-header-actions. The typical use is a host-styled close affordance - e.g. a text TmButton Close paired with ShowCloseButton=false - or additional header actions. Null (the default) keeps today's header DOM unchanged. Content renders INSIDE the focus scope, so the Tab cycle covers it.

parameters.name: CloseButtonAdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: Extra attributes splatted onto the built-in close button - a host-owned data-testid or a stable focus hook the host's restore path targets. Rendered only with ShowCloseButton; never overrides the button's type, class, click handler or accessible name.

parameters.name: OkButtonText
parameters.description: Confirm button text. Defaults to the localized Tm_Ok when not set.

parameters.name: CancelButtonText
parameters.description: Dismiss button text. Defaults to the localized Tm_Cancel when not set.

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the modal presents on a narrow viewport. Auto follows the viewport scope: a sheet on mobile, a dialog otherwise. AutoFullscreen is the same choice for a TALL surface (a tabbed form, a table, a preview): a fullscreen panel on mobile, the centred dialog otherwise, because a sheet would clip it. A forced Sheet, Fullscreen or Dialog renders that presentation without measuring, so a test can render it without a DOM.

parameters.name: FooterLayout
parameters.description: How the footer buttons are arranged. Inline keeps them side by side at every width; Stacked stacks them full width.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the modal renders. Auto follows the viewport scope; a forced value renders that mode without a DOM.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement, and the layout rendered when no viewport scope exists.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the rendered layout changes. The initial value is not a change. Never pair it with LayoutMode.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTarget
parameters.description: The element focus returns to when the modal closes. A disconnected or inside-the-modal target is skipped (it would die with the overlay) and the restore falls back to the opener; a focus the app placed on a live element outside before the close render is never stolen.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the restore target, for a target rendered outside the modal. Same skip rules as RestoreFocusTarget: a disconnected or inside-the-modal target falls back to the opener.

parameters.name: RestoreFocus
parameters.description: Whether the modal's focus scope restores focus on close. Default true (the opener is remembered at activation and focus returns there, or to an explicit restore target). Set false when the HOST owns the restore — e.g. an editor that closes the dialog through its own path and moves focus afterwards: the scope then renders data-restore-focus="false" and the module skips the restore.

parameters.name: InitialFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element that receives focus when the modal opens.

parameters.name: DialogRole
parameters.description: The role of the trapped surface. dialog (the default) for a normal modal; alertdialog for a surface whose message IS the content and whose actions are the only way out.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: The id of the element that describes the modal, wired to the scope's aria-describedby — used by an alertdialog, whose body text is the description.

parameters.name: RestoreFocus
parameters.description: Whether closing the modal restores the focus it took. Defaults to true; false leaves the focus where the close action put it.

parameters.name: InitialFocusSelector
parameters.description: A CSS selector for the element that receives focus when the modal opens — for a target without a stable id or a set where the first match is right (a checked radio, the first checkbox). Resolved inside the focus scope; when it matches nothing the scope falls back to InitialFocusTargetId and then to its first-focusable path. Additive: null keeps the previous behaviour.
